title: You Needed Me
lyrics_synced:
[00:17.06] I cried a tear, you wiped it dry
[00:24.44] I was confused, you cleared my mind
[00:31.83] I sold my soul, you bought it back for me
[00:39.21] And held me up and gave me dignity
[00:46.60] Somehow you needed me
[00:50.29] You gave me strength to stand alone again
[00:57.67] To face the world out on my own again
[01:05.06] You put me high upon a pedestal
[01:13.37] So high that I could almost see eternity
[01:20.75] You needed me, you needed me
[01:28.13] And I can't believe it's you,
[01:30.90] I can't believe it's true
[01:35.54] I needed you and you were there
[01:42.90] And I'll never leave why should I leave,
[01:46.37] I'd be a fool
[01:50.31] 'Cause I've finally found someone
[01:53.08] who really cares
[02:00.44] You held my hand when it was cold
[02:07.83] When I was lost you took me home
[02:15.21] You gave me hope when I was at the end
[02:22.62] And turned my lies back into truth again
[02:29.98] You even called me friend
[02:33.67] You gave me strength to stand alone again
[02:41.06] To face the world out on my own again
[02:48.44] You put me high upon a pedestal
[02:56.75] So high that I could almost see eternity
[03:04.13] You needed me, you needed me
[03:11.52] You needed me, you needed me
